senses.gloss: to crush, squeeze, esp. to rub ears for husking the grain.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 13a:2">Bets. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>למוֹלְלָן במלילות</he> with the intention of husking them when parched.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:22">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:22">XVII</cite>), 22; <cite ref="Shabbat 12a:9">Sabb. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>מוֹלֵל</he> he rubs it between two fingers; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01516"><he>מָלוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:17">Tosef. ib. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:17">XV</cite>), 17 <he>מוֹלְלִין את המ׳</he> you may husk that which needs husking.

senses.gloss: to stir a mush, make a pulp.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 40b:6">Pes. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מוֹלְלִין … והרוצה שיִמְלוֹל וכ׳</he> you must not stir a dish (in the usual way) on Passover, but he who desires to make a mush, must put in the flour and then add vinegar.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:7">Tosef. Maasr. I, 7</cite> <he>מן המלול</he> ed. (ed. Zuck. <he>המאמל</he>, Var. <he>הממל</he>) out of the olive pulp.

senses.gloss: to be compressible, (of webs) to be soft and downy.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 59a:16">Gitt. 59ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>מ̇ל̇ת̇ח̇ה</he>, <cite ref="II Kings 10:22">II Kings X, 22</cite>) <he>דבר הנמ̇ל̇ל ונמת̇ח̇</he> a cloth which can be compressed (creased) and stretched (again, showing no creases when unfolded); [Rashi: a stuff the thread of which is twisted between the spinner’s fingers and stretched].—V. <cite ref="M01604"><he>מַלְמֵלָה</he></cite>.
